title: Transfer - Assembly Balance Check
goal: Analyze a noisy binary STL assembly scan with several meaningful connected components, ignore debris, derive each component's mass from attribute-coded material IDs, and report the assembly center of mass plus a balance pass/fail result against a mounting footprint.
skillBenefitRationale: This keeps the same domain and core mesh benefits while transferring from single-part inspection to assembly-level reasoning that depends on connected-component decomposition, per-component volume, and attribute-driven material properties.
